Choisissez le logiciel qui fait référenc: Choose the software that refers to the invoice, its maturity and the amount left. Do not deduct that a bill is unpaid because an e-mail did not receive a reply. Partial payments and assets must be taken into account. Missing data triggers internal verification, not automatic re-launch.
Le rappel d’une facture repose d’abord s: The reminder of an invoice is based first on up-to-date accounting data. An AI is not necessary to compare a date and balance; it may possibly prepare a draft adapted to the context, subject to company rules.
Le récapitulatif présente l’entreprise,: The summary presents the company, the invoice reference, the due date and the known balance, with the timing. The person who is valid must be able to suspend a file in dispute. The message avoids inventing penalties or contractual conditions. The parts and coordinates used are those of the invoice validated.
Le scénario n’effectue pas de recouvreme: The scenario does not make legal recovery and does not replace the audit. Connectors must be available.
Recette : règlement partiel et pièce con: Recipe: Partial settlement and disputed document
Testez séparément une facture entièremen: Test a fully paid invoice, partial balance and disputed item separately. The first spell of the course; the other two require an adapted qualification. Change the balance after preparation of draft and before validation. Text to be sent must be recalculated from the accounting source, with a record of the version used and the person who validated the message.
Une facture peut être payée entre la pré: An invoice may be paid between the preparation of the reminder and the shipment. Reread the condition at the last moment and cancel the reminder if necessary. Simulate a partial payment, an asset and two identical confirmations of payment. A sync failure leaves the folder to check in order not to claim an obsolete amount.
Une facture préparée pour rappel reçoit: An invoice prepared for reminder receives a partial payment. The proposed scenario suspends the draft and requests confirmation of the new balance before sending. Illustrative case.
